name: 2C-T-16
summary: 2C-T-16, also known as 4-allylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug. It was originally named by Alexander Shulgin as described in his book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines i Have Known And Loved), however while Shulgin began synthesis of this compound he only got as far as the nitrostyrene intermediate, and did not complete the final synthetic step.

pharmacology.text: Binding studies in vitro showed 2C-T-16 to have a binding affinity of 44 nM at 5-HT2A and 15 nM at 5-HT2C. 2C-T-16 and related derivatives are potent partial agonists of the 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C receptors and induce a head-twitch response in mice.

uses.en: It has appeared as a rare research chemical and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾以罕見研究化學品的形式出現，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以罕见研究化学品的形式出现，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: The 2C-T drugs put a sulfur atom where 2C-B has its bromine. In 2C-T-16, that sulfur carries an allyl group, a short chain with a double bond.
fact.zh: 2C-T 類藥物在 2C-B 的溴原子位置放了一個硫原子。在 2C-T-16 中，這個硫原子上連著烯丙基，也就是一條帶雙鍵的短鏈。
fact.zhHans: 2C-T 类药物在 2C-B 的溴原子位置放了一个硫原子。在 2C-T-16 中，这个硫原子上连着烯丙基，也就是一条带双键的短链。
